title: Obesity, morbid obesity and BMI
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's weight diagnosis and BMI, if reportable.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for weight management.

HPI: Pt is a 78-year-old male presenting today for a scheduled follow-up regarding weight management and obesity. Pt reports difficulty maintaining a caloric deficit despite efforts to increase physical activity. He states he has been trying to walk more but finds his stamina limited. He denies any acute pain, shortness of breath, or chest pain today. He is seeking guidance on dietary modifications and structured exercise.

Medication List:
- Lisinopril 10mg daily
- Atorvastatin 20mg daily
- Multivitamin daily

Vitals:
BP: 138/84
HR: 72 (RRR)
Temp: 98.6 F
SpO2: 97% on RA
Height: 5'9"
Weight: 334 lbs
BMI 52.4

Recent Labs:
HbA1c: 6.2%
eGFR: 78
LDL: 95 mg/dL
TSH: 2.1 mIU/L

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: Denies fever, chills, fatigue.
CV: Denies palpitations, syncope.
Resp: Denies cough, SOB.
GI: Denies nausea, diarrhea.
MSK: Denies joint pain.
Neuro: Denies dizziness, numbness.

Social History: Pt lives with wife. Retired. Non-smoker. Occasional alcohol use.

Family History: Father had hypertension, history of stroke. Mother had type 2 diabetes.

Exam:
General: Alert and oriented x3. Well-nourished. In no acute distress.
CV: RRR, S1, S2. No murmurs.
Resp: CTAB.
Abd: Soft, non-tender, non-distended.
Ext: No edema.

Assessment:
1. Obesity: Pt presents with significant weight gain. Discussion held regarding lifestyle modifications. 
2. Hypertension: Stable on current meds.

Plan:
1. Obesity: Provided extensive diet and activity counseling. Advised pt to increase daily caloric deficit and aim for 30 minutes of low-impact walking 5 days/week. Pt to keep a food log for 2 weeks.
2. Follow-up: Return to clinic in 3 months to monitor weight and blood pressure.

Electronically signed,
T. Haddad, MD
05/14/2026
explanations: Obesity documented by the provider: E66.9. The coder does not upgrade it to morbid obesity from the BMI.
BMI 52.x with a provider weight diagnosis: add Z68.43 (BMI 40 or more maps to HCC 48 on its own).

distractors.why: Only the provider can diagnose morbid obesity; the BMI does not change the diagnosis.
The BMI is documented and the provider diagnosed the weight condition: add the Z68 code.
